questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cartons are boxes.

No box is a sheet.

Conclusions:

(I) No carton is a sheet.

(II) Some sheets are boxes.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All cartons are boxes.**
No box is a sheet.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/300f8ff33a70f103b28b23ba9b81d9a8f9c0e0ddf8b9eebc3de67167d50cdc55.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) No carton is a sheet:**

Since Cartons** are entirely inside **Boxes**, and **Boxes** have no overlap with **Sheets**, it follows that **Cartons** also have no overlap with **Sheets**.

**(II) Some sheets are boxes: **

This is the contradiction of Statement 2 (**No box is a sheet**).

If "No box is a sheet" is true, then "Some sheets are boxes" (meaning some Sheets are also Boxes) must be false.

So, **Only conclusion (I) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

Some Cats are Turkeys.

So, **Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
